title: A fresh new look
items: New design with light and dark mode (Options → Appearance)
Navigation bar – on phones at the bottom of the screen
Exercise cards show goal, time left, progress and your streak at a glance
Simpler form for new exercises with a real time picker
Statistics with your streaks, completion per person and who finished when
Groups show their members; accept or decline invitations right away
What's new is shown once after an update – like this
Install the app on your phone's home screen – it starts without the browser bar and shows a message when you are offline
Large timer view while a timer runs – the screen stays on
On phones: a round + button for new exercises and groups, dialogs use the whole screen and page titles stay visible while scrolling
Sort your exercises by dragging them (sort icon at the top) and pull the page down to refresh it
On phones the top bar shows the page title with a back arrow – log out is now in Options
Statistics: the details of a day stay on the screen and are shown on tap
Reminders: get a notification when an exercise is not done yet shortly before it resets (Options → General)
The app loads faster (a third less to download)
A note at the top shows when you are offline; your phone vibrates briefly when you mark an exercise as done
New and edited exercises get their own page instead of a small dialog
Statistics only show people who currently take part and were active in the selected time
Fixed: reset times now follow summer and winter time (they moved by an hour before)
Fixed: tapping "Mark as done" several times quickly no longer causes errors
Fixed: creating exercises, the back button, a timer that finished immediately and the time left below one hour

title: Missed entries
items: Add a missed entry for a period you finished but forgot to track
Fixed: groups were not shown when editing an exercise

title: Options and invite links
items: Options page with invite link generation

title: Timers
items: Exercise cards collapse when you mark them as done

Better layout on small screens
